song_craft: Voice: stotra-address couplets — Abhinavagupta’s own hymn, first person throughout, vocatives load-bearing every verse (row 7). Arc: veneration-by-becoming (v1) → two-step recognition (v2) → fear-denied-suffering-kept (v3) → death defied (v4) → fearlessness finished (v5) → awakening→ingress (v6) → affliction-as-occasion (v7) → rites relativized (v8) → dancing consciousness (v9) → dated seal cooling the world (v10). Recognition performed, not argued. L4 = L3 verbatim, music named.

lines: You, Lord, pervade my own self — so there is no talk of transmigration-fear.
Even while hard-to-bear suffering, delusion, and terror-causing karma-hosts stand.
l4.sanskrit_cite: svātmani viśvagaye tvayi nāthe tena na saṃsṛtibhītikathāsti satsv api durdharaduḥkhavimohatrāsavidhāyiṣu karmagaṇeṣu

verses.craft: Denial-and-concession in one breath (no-fear-talk + full-suffering together); prāyeṇa/karmagaṇa opens kept.
verses.rejected: (a) deferring resolution → killed: resolved within, not deferred. (b) universalizing fear → killed: fear-talk denied, suffering conceded — both kept.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Whether 'prāyeṇa' (mostly) softens the claim or qualifies it is unresolved.", "Whether 'karmagaṇa' means masses of karma or hosts of karmic beings is unresolved."]) / C1 essence / rasa śānta (tranquility) with karuṇa (compassion) / L2+L3 voice
